title: Par or birdie?
hook: Does the same-length putt carry the same pressure?

knows: basic arithmetic and reading a small table
doesNotKnow: Separate an observational scoring difference from a claim that pressure caused it.

misconception: The quantities in this case can be combined without checking their reference, denominator, or information boundary.
objective: Separate an observational scoring difference from a claim that pressure caused it.
keyState: Both complete computed cases are visible as retained observations; the question-case picture survives Reset.

claims.text: In this toy scorecard, 92 of 100 par putts and 88 of 100 birdie putts succeed. What difference is observed? Toy inputs A=[92, 100, 88, 100]; B=[90, 100, 90, 100].
claims.source: Local explicit hypothetical assumptions in spec.ts and model.ts; not participant measurements.

claims.text: Computed results: [[92, 88, 4.0000000000000036], [90, 90, 0]]. Labels: Par %, Birdie %, Gap pp.
claims.source: compute() in the lesson-local model.ts; finite numeric operations over the explicit inputs.

claims.text: The scorecard compares success rates, not randomly assigned pressure. Equal matched rates in B illustrate why an observed gap alone cannot identify its cause.
claims.source: The two controlled cases in spec.ts; scope limited to these toy inputs and displayed model rule.

claims.text: A new toy case uses Par hits=90, Par tries=100, Birdie hits=90, Birdie tries=100. What is Gap pp? Answer: 0.
claims.source: compute() applied to the contrasting new input case; source list is an idea pointer only.

recall.question: A new toy case uses Par hits=90, Par tries=100, Birdie hits=90, Birdie tries=100. What is Gap pp?
recall.why: Applying the stated toy rule to the new inputs gives 0. The result depends on these assumptions; it is not a universal behavioral response.

sourceProvenance.text: PGA pros sink par putts a few percentage points more often than equally long birdie putts, because missing par feels like a loss (Pope & Schweitzer, 2011).
sourceProvenance.caveat: Original list says figures are approximate and papers were not individually rechecked. No empirical source is verified by this build.

meaningfulDifference: Separate an observational scoring difference from a claim that pressure caused it.
